contract: Premium architectural/engineering redesign of the actual local RAMIVLAD INSTAL site: a new photo-led homepage, substantive service/project page compositions, verified Romanian scope, direct phone contact and explicit email drafting; all original routes, business facts, SEO and Pages base-path support retained. See README.md.

accessibility.evidence: 18 local browser page/viewport checks passed with zero axe violations and no page errors. Menu/Escape, skip link, labels, invalid contact and whitespace validation, draft-without-POST, images and HTTP behavior were exercised. Manual screenshot review included the dark contact and draft states. This is not full human screen-reader certification.

responsive.evidence: Before, pass1 and refined captures cover all 12 public pages at 1440, 768 and 390 widths. Root inspected full homepage captures at all three sizes and service/portfolio/gallery/certificate/privacy page captures; a delegated reviewer inspected eight additional page/viewport combinations and menu widths 320–850. Regression widths 360/390/768/1024/1440 had no horizontal overflow. Mobile line-break spacing and intrinsic gallery image sizing were corrected.

loading.reason: No application data-loading state exists: pages are pre-rendered. Native image/font loading is handled with reserved intrinsic image dimensions, responsive sources and font swap/preloads. Dimensions/descriptor correctness were tested; local Lighthouse CLS was 0 on measured pages. No separate slow-gallery field test is claimed.

empty.reason: Service/project data is fixed source content, not an empty user account or asynchronous listing. All three verified galleries remain complete.

error.evidence: Browser tests rejected invalid contact information and whitespace-only descriptions. The actual invalid state was captured in screenshots/form-invalid.png. The local missing-page journey returned 404.

partial.reason: There is no partial API dataset. Missing authentic sanitary/staff imagery and unverified project metadata are documented as asset requests; no invented replacements or specifications are displayed.

success.evidence: Root inspected screenshots/form-draft.png in the new dark contact design. Valid input produced a visible draft, encoded email link and copy action, with explicit unsent wording and no POST. No email application was launched.

permission.reason: The website is public static content without account permissions. The separate owner boundary was respected: no push, production deployment or DNS action occurred.

renderedEvidence.observation: Actual complete desktop page inspected, including heating-system opening, differentiated service spread, project overview/detail pairs, company information and dark contact ending; supporting page captures were also inspected.
Actual complete tablet page inspected. Navigation, photographic proportions, service columns, portfolio rows and contact form remain composed without overflow.

Actual complete mobile page and readable section captures inspected. The layout has deliberate image/text ordering, usable phone/menu controls, corrected heading spaces and no fixed overlay crossing photographs.
Actual draft state inspected: readable light text, visible textarea, explicit no-send explanation and clear email/copy actions.

checks.static: Root and /Ramivlad2 production builds passed: 13 pages, 386 local references plus responsive variants. Exact intrinsic dimensions, unique srcset descriptors and all 25 original gallery links checked.
checks.browser: 18 checks passed; zero axe violations and page errors.
checks.limits: Local lab results only; no production deployment, field INP, human user study or conversion-uplift measurement.
